bukhari:1902.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:1902.note: Ibn Abbas: Jibril met the Prophet every night of Ramadan; the Prophet recited the Qur'an to him

bukhari:4998.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:4998.note: Abu Huraira: Jibril went over the Qur'an once a year, twice in the year he died

bukhari:5006.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:5006.note: Abu Said al-Mu'alla: the Fatihah is the seven oft-repeated ayat and the great Qur'an

bukhari:5031.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:5031.note: Ibn Umar: the one who knows the Qur'an is like the owner of tied camels

bukhari:5032.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:5032.note: Abdullah: do not say 'I forgot such-and-such ayah'; keep reciting, it escapes faster than camels

bukhari:5046.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:5046.note: Qatada asked Anas about the Prophet's recitation: prolongation; he recited the basmala showing the madd

bukhari:5049.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:5049.note: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: the Prophet asked him to recite to him ('I like to hear it from others'); not a half-date hadith

bukhari:6227.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:6227.note: Abu Huraira: Adam is told to greet the angels and hear their reply; they answered with 'wa rahmatullah' added

bukhari:6231.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:6231.note: Abu Huraira: the young greet the old, the passer-by the sitting, the small group the large

bukhari:6251.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:6251.note: Abu Huraira: the man who prayed badly greeted the Prophet, who replied wa alaykas-salam and told him to pray again

muslim:2380.grader: Sahih Muslim (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
muslim:2380.note: Ubayy ibn Ka'b: Musa and al-Khidr; Musa greets, al-Khidr replies wa alaykumus-salam (source of the reply words in the phrase registry)

tirmidhi:2689.grader: Al-Albani (also graded hasan by Bashar Awad Maarouf; Zubair Ali Zai: isnad hasan)
tirmidhi:2689.note: Imran ibn Husayn: the man says as-salamu alaykum, the Prophet says ten; with wa rahmatullah, twenty; with wa barakatuh, thirty

abudawud:5197.note: Abu Umamah: those nearest to Allah are the first to give the greeting
